name: BCC Marching Tetrahedra with Permutation-Based Lookup
definition: A GPU-based isosurface extraction method for Body-Centered Cubic (BCC) volume datasets that uses a single reference tetrahedron lookup table and applies 3D permutation transformations to handle all six cell types, avoiding a large lookup table.
summary: BCC Marching Tetrahedra with Permutation-Based Lookup extracts GPU isosurfaces from BCC volumes by storing connectivity for one reference tetrahedron and applying permutation transformations to reduce memory overhead.
